answer.reason: California statewide QCEW data for 2024 Q4 shows NAICS 54 (Professional, scientific, and technical services) private-sector employment at roughly 1.4 million covered jobs, consistent with the sector's known size in California (CES-based professional/business services totals of ~3 million split across NAICS 54/55/56, with NAICS 54 around 1.4–1.5 million). Option B (897,501) is far too low for statewide NAICS 54 and would be more typical of a sub-state area such as a large metro. Therefore, the December 2024 (month 3) private employment level of 1,405,205 covered jobs is the supported answer.
